messages.subject: Re: error when using debug mode
messages.body_plain:
Hi Wei,

the debug mode is only available for the launch type RJ (first setting 
in the launch configuration).

Regards,
Stephan

messages.subject: MonetDBLite
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

 

I was trying to follow the examples on the page of the just-released
MonetDBLite, https://www.monetdb.org/blog/monetdblite-r, but ran into a
problem: the package installs correctly, and can be loaded in an R console
without problems. When I try and load it in an Statet session, I get the
following error messages:

 

Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'MonetDBLite', details:

  call: dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...)

  error: unable to load shared object
'/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/MonetDBLite/libs/libmonetdb5.so':

  /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/MonetDBLite/libs/libmonetdb5.so: undefined
symbol: R_NilValue

Error: package or namespace load failed for 'MonetDBLite'

 

I'm running Eclipse 3.8.1, StatET 3.3.2, and Ubuntu 14.04.

 

Anybody any idea? Help much appreciated!

 

Cheers,

 

Edward Vanden Berghe

Data Scientist, European Data Innovation Hub
